slides.teacher_cue: ou has a third sound. In some words, ou = /ʌ/: young, touch, double, country, trouble. This is the same short /ʌ/ as in cup and mud. ough is the most unpredictable spelling in English — it has at least six pronunciations: through = /uː/, though = /oʊ/, thought = /ɔːt/, tough/rough/enough = /ʌf/, cough = /ɒf/, bough = /aʊ/. Students must learn ough words as lexical items — the pattern alone is not reliable.
slides.expected_response: Students recognise ou = /ʌ/ in specific high-frequency words and approach ough words with vocabulary-level knowledge.
slides.correction_move: Establish ou = /ʌ/ words as a group: young, touch, double, country, trouble. Then sort ough words by sound. Acknowledge honestly: ough is irregular — context and vocabulary are essential.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students applying the /aʊ/ rule from L42 to all ou words — ou has three sounds now.

slides.teacher_cue: Say young — not old. ou = /ʌ/ here — same as cup. y = /j/ consonant. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say young orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model young orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for ou = /ʌ/ — not /aʊ/ or /uː/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say touch — ou = /ʌ/, ch at end. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say touch orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model touch orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for ou = /ʌ/ and /tʃ/ at end.

slides.teacher_cue: Say tough — ough = /ʌf/ here. Same as rough and enough. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say tough orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model tough orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for ough = /ʌf/ — not /aʊ/ or /uː/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say through — ough = /uː/ here. This is different from tough. thr triple cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say through orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model through orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for ough = /uː/ in through — contrast with tough.

slides.teacher_cue: Say thought — ough = /ɔːt/ here. th + ought. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say thought orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model thought orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for ough = /ɔːt/ — three of the ough sounds in three lessons.

slides.teacher_cue: Say double — ou = /ʌ/ in first syllable, -le ending. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say double orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model double orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for ou = /ʌ/ and unstressed -le.
